summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Pinball Quest, a Nintendo Entertainment System video game developed by TOSE and published by Jaleco in 1990. It describes the game as based on pinball, and notes that its role-playing elements distinguish it from other pinball-based video games.
one_line: Pinball Quest is a 1990 NES game by TOSE and Jaleco that blends pinball with role-playing elements.
key_facts: Pinball Quest is the name of a Nintendo Entertainment System video game.
Pinball Quest was developed by TOSE.
Pinball Quest was published by Jaleco.
Pinball Quest is based on the popular arcade game pinball.
The role playing aspect of Pinball Quest makes it unique from other pinball based video games.
